info.title: Busora API
info.description:
Busora bus-ticket booking API (educational demo).

**Booking flow:** cities → search flights → select a flight → passenger form → validate passengers → start checkout → pay (mock page or LiqPay) → ticket summary and PDF download. Booking state lives in a session cookie (`busora-sess`), so a browser client must send credentials; the web app calls the API through a same-origin proxy.

**Errors** share one shape (`ErrorResponse`) with a machine-readable `code`.

**Admin flow:** JWT login required. Access token goes in `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.

bearerAuth.description: Admin JWT access token obtained from `POST /api/admin/auth/login`

SessionExpiresTime.description: Booking session lifetime in ms (900000); the session cookie expires this long after it was created.

code.description: Machine-readable reason. Clients localise their message from this.

errors.description: Details: a list of `{ field, message }` objects, or for passenger validation a map of field → localised messages.

currency.description: Currency prices are shown in when travelling from here

id.description: Id of this offer within the current session — pass it to `POST /api/bus-flights/select`.

from.description: Route and stops of one direction. Empty object for the return leg of a one-way or open-date trip.

to.description: Route and stops of one direction. Empty object for the return leg of a one-way or open-date trip.

departure.description: Display date in the requested language

discountPercentage.description: Promo discount on this flight, 0 when none

purePriceFull.description: Price per passenger before the promo, digits only

purePrice.description: Price per passenger in the search currency, digits only

isMain.description: `true` for an offer from the main search, `false` for one from the alternatives

direction.description: For alternatives: outbound (forwards) or return leg

group.description: Which passengers the discounts apply to

PassengersInfo.description: Passenger details as validated and stored in the session. Keys are `adult-passenger-N` / `child-passenger-N`; each value holds fields suffixed with the same N (`name-N`, `last-name-N`, `phone-N`, `email-N`, `date-of-birth-N`, `discount-N`, `card-discount-N`) plus the computed `full-ticket-price-N`, `discount-ticket-price-N` and `discount-percentage-N`.

ticketPrice.description: Price per passenger before personal discounts

showDiscounts.description: False when the selected flight already has a promo — personal discounts do not stack with it

passengersInfo.description: Details entered earlier in this session, for prefilling

price.description: Total for all passengers in the search currency, after discounts

bookingPageParams.description: Opaque client state (e.g. the booking page query string). The only key a client may write.

amount.description: Amount to be charged, in UAH

data.description: Signed payment result — pass it with `signature` to the ticket summary and download endpoints

kind.description: Passengers board at boarding stops and leave at drop-off stops

dayOffset.description: Days after departure from the first stop (0 = same day)

weekdays.description: Departure days from the first stop, 0 = Sunday

directions.description: Outbound first (lower route id), then inbound

currency.description: Currency fares from this city are shown in

price.description: Ticket total; the sum of every passenger's price.

passengerPrice.description: This passenger's price: (paymentAtOffice + paymentOnBus) × discount multiplier.

type.description: Ticket type ({ id, name }); id is the ticket_type meta id.

status.description: Ticket status ({ id, name }); id is the ticket_status meta id.

passengerType.description: Passenger type; id/name are the enum value (adult|child).

agent.description: Assigned agent ({ id, name }); id "0" = no agent.

passengerConfirmation.description: Confirmation status ({ id, name }); id "0" = none.

post.summary: Create the ticket after a LiqPay widget payment
post.description: Called by the browser after the LiqPay widget reports success, racing the server callback. Creates the ticket and its per-passenger PDFs if the callback has not yet; idempotent per transaction.

400.description: BAD_REQUEST — invalid signature or unsuccessful payment

post.summary: Summary of a paid booking for the success page
post.description: Takes the signed payment result returned by the payment step and answers with the ticket in plain JSON. Ends the booking session.
One PDF for a single passenger, otherwise a ZIP with one PDF per passenger.

404.description: NOT_FOUND — no ticket for this payment

post.summary: Report a failed LiqPay widget payment
post.description: Logs the failure and ends the booking session.

get.summary: Booking summary for the review step

401.description: SESSION_NOT_STARTED (no or expired booking session) or FLIGHT_NOT_SELECTED

post.summary: Save client state in the booking session
post.description: Stores bookingPageParams so the client can restore its booking page. Any other key, or a non-string value, is rejected with 400 — prices, rates and passenger data are only ever set by the server.

400.description: BAD_REQUEST — a key other than bookingPageParams

get.summary: Whether a booking session is active

post.summary: Start checkout for the current booking
post.description: Recalculates the price on the server, saves the booking for the payment callback and returns a checkout signed by the configured provider. With provider liqpay, open the LiqPay widget with data and signature. With provider mock, show a fake payment page and finish it with POST /api/payment/mock/complete.

post.summary: Finish a mock checkout (demo payments only)
post.description: Available only when PAYMENT_PROVIDER is mock. On success the ticket, per-passenger PDFs and email are produced exactly as for a real payment; completing the same checkout again creates nothing new. The returned data and signature work with /api/tickets/summary and /api/tickets/download-pdf.

200.description: Payment result with its signed payload

404.description: NOT_FOUND — the mock provider is not enabled

post.description: Webhook called directly by LiqPay servers after payment is processed (PAYMENT_PROVIDER=liqpay). Verifies the signature, creates/reuses the ticket, generates PDFs, sends confirmation emails, and cleans up expired sessions. **This endpoint should not be called manually.**

data.description: Base64-encoded JSON payment data from LiqPay

get.summary: Data for the passenger form
get.description: Passenger counts, the price per passenger, the personal discounts that can be chosen (names in languageCode) and any details entered earlier.

401.description: SESSION_NOT_STARTED (no or expired booking session) or FLIGHT_NOT_SELECTED

post.summary: Validate passenger details and save them to the booking
post.description: Phones must be Ukrainian (+380) or Czech (+420). The first adult's email receives the tickets. Must succeed before POST /api/payment.

401.description: SESSION_NOT_STARTED (no or expired booking session) or FLIGHT_NOT_SELECTED

422.description: VALIDATION_FAILED; errors maps each invalid field to messages in languageCode

get.summary: The bus network for the routes, schedule and fares pages
get.description: Cities, the lines with both directions (stops, times, the weekdays they run) and every fare in UAH and CZK. Public and cacheable; it does not touch the booking session.

get.summary: Personal discounts, for the fares page
get.description: Every personal discount, including those that are seasonally inactive today (their name says when). Booking offers only the currently valid ones, via GET /api/passengers.

get.summary: Get currencies by abbreviation

parameters.name: currencyAbbr
parameters.description: Comma-separated ISO 4217 currency codes (max 10). Repeated array format also accepted.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated extra fields to include (allowed: name, abbr, symbol). id is always returned.

get.summary: Cities grouped by country
get.description: Only cities that have a name in the requested language are listed.

parameters.name: excludedCountry
parameters.description: Leave out this country's cities

get.summary: Search bus flights (starts a booking)
get.description: Returns the offers for a route and date. Starts a new booking session (sets the session cookie) with the first offer pre-selected; the other booking endpoints work on this session.

parameters.name: currencyAbbr
parameters.description: Currency of the returned prices (UAH or CZK)

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Return date (round trip), or one-way / open-date

get.summary: Nearest later flights for one direction
get.description: Up to three departure dates after startDate with free seats. For the outbound direction without a selected flight this starts a new booking session, like the main search.

parameters.name: currencyAbbr
parameters.description: Currency of the returned prices (UAH or CZK)

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Alternatives depart after this date

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Return date (round trip), or one-way / open-date

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: forwards for the outbound leg, backwards for the return leg

get.summary: Bookable departure dates for the calendar
get.description: Dates with at least one flight with free seats for the city pair.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Only dates on or after this one (defaults to today)

post.summary: Select an offer for the booking
post.description: Selects an offer returned by the search or the alternatives in this session. For a round trip from alternatives, select the outbound offer (direction forwards) and then the return offer (direction backwards).

400.description: BAD_REQUEST — no such offer in this session

get.summary: List tickets (paginated, filterable, sortable)

post.description: Creates a ticket without going through the LiqPay payment flow. A synthetic transaction ID and signature are generated.

type.description: Ticket type { id, name }; backend reads name (resolved to a meta key).

price.description: Calculated by the form; optional on create.

status.description: Ticket status { id, name }; backend reads name (resolved to a meta key).

discount.description: Ticket discount { percentage, name }; backend reads percentage.

get.summary: Get ticket status and type lookup values
get.description: Returns the localised label/value pairs for ticket statuses (not-payed, payed, etc.) and types (one-way, open-date, round).

confirmations.description: Confirmation statuses, incl. a synthetic "0" (no confirmation).

get.summary: Download a ticket PDF (admin)
get.description: When `passengerId` is given, returns that passenger's individual PDF. When omitted, falls back to the legacy combined ticket PDF.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Ticket ID

parameters.name: passengerId
parameters.description: Optional — download only this passenger's PDF

post.summary: Add a passenger to an existing ticket
post.description: Attaches an existing passenger (by `id`) or creates a new one (via `data`) and links them to the specified ticket. Also decrements `freeSeats` on the associated bus flight.

ticketId.description: Ticket ID to add the passenger to

id.description: Existing passenger ID (omit to create a new one)

data.description: New passenger data (used when `id` is omitted)

post.summary: Email ticket PDF to a recipient
post.description: Sends the ticket PDF(s) to the given email address. When `passengerId` is provided, only that passenger's PDF is attached; otherwise all passenger PDFs are attached.

passengerId.description: Optional — send only this passenger's PDF

post.description: Generates one PDF per passenger (adult + child). When `passengerId` is provided, only that passenger's PDF is (re)generated; otherwise every passenger on the ticket is regenerated. Old PDFs are replaced and the new filenames are written back to `passengertickets.PDFFileName`.

post.summary: Delete generated PDF(s) for a ticket
post.description: Deletes generated PDF file(s) and clears the corresponding DB pointers. When `passengerId` is provided, that passenger's per-passenger PDF is deleted; if it has none, the legacy ticket-level PDF (its fallback) is deleted instead. Without `passengerId`, every per-passenger PDF plus the ticket-level PDF are removed. Idempotent: anything already absent is skipped.

passengerId.description: Optional — delete only this passenger's PDF

put.description: Updates ticket metadata (dates, flight, price, status, discount) and the passenger's fields when `passengerId` is supplied. Because edited fields appear on the generated tickets, any existing PDFs (ticket-level and per-passenger) are invalidated, so they must be regenerated afterwards.

type.description: Ticket type { id, name }; backend reads id (the ticket_type meta id).

price.description: Ignored; recalculated as the sum of per-passenger prices.

status.description: Ticket status { id, name }; backend reads id (the ticket_status meta id).

discount.description: Ticket discount { percentage, name }; backend reads percentage.

passengerId.description: Original passenger id of the row; used to locate the junction row to update.

newPassengerId.description: Selected existing passenger to re-link this row to. When present and different from passengerId, the junction row is re-pointed to this passenger and the target passenger's identity is left untouched. Omit (or equal to passengerId) for a plain edit.

passengerConfirmation.description: Confirmation status; id matches a confirmation_type meta, or "0" for none.

agent.description: Assigned agent; id matches an agent, or "0" for none.

paymentAtOfficeUAH.description: Amount paid at office, in UAH — the stored truth. The booking-currency paymentAtOffice is derived from it (round(UAH / rate)). Preferred over paymentAtOffice.

paymentOnBusUAH.description: Amount paid on bus, in UAH — the stored truth. The booking-currency paymentOnBus is derived from it. Preferred over paymentOnBus.

paymentAtOffice.description: Legacy: amount in the ticket's booking currency; used (lifted to UAH × rate) only when paymentAtOfficeUAH is absent.

paymentOnBus.description: Legacy: amount in the ticket's booking currency; used (lifted to UAH × rate) only when paymentOnBusUAH is absent.

passengerType.description: Passenger type { id, name }; backend reads id (adult|child).

delete.description: Deletes the ticket and its PDF files, and restores `freeSeats` on associated flights.

delete.summary: Remove a passenger from a ticket
delete.description: Unlinks the passenger from the ticket, deletes that passenger's PDF, and restores one free seat. For `type=child`, also deletes the child passenger row. If the passenger is the last one on the ticket, the whole ticket is deleted instead (all junction rows, child passengers, and ticket-level + per-passenger PDF files), restoring all its seats.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Ticket ID

parameters.name: passengerId
parameters.description: Passenger ID to remove

get.summary: Autocomplete search for agents
get.description: Returns up to 8 agents whose name contains the search string.

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: Search string (substring match on agent name)

get.summary: Autocomplete search for bus flights by date (and optionally city pair)
get.description: Returns bus flights whose `dateOfDeparture` matches the date extracted from the search string. When `originId` and `destinationId` are both supplied, the result is further restricted to flights whose route actually connects that city pair in the requested `direction` (the origin must be an onboarding stop and the destination an outboarding stop), so an admin only sees flights that can serve the selected route. Without the city params it behaves as before (date-only, capped at 4 results).

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: Search string containing a date (various formats accepted)

parameters.name: originId
parameters.description: Origin city ID. When set together with destinationId, flights are filtered to this city pair.

parameters.name: destinationId
parameters.description: Destination city ID. When set together with originId, flights are filtered to this city pair.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Travel direction relative to the city pair. `forwards` = origin → destination (departure flight); `backwards` = destination → origin (return flight).

get.summary: Autocomplete search for passengers by phone number
get.description: Returns up to 8 passengers whose phone contains the numeric portion of the search string.

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: Search string (digits extracted and matched against phone last 7 digits)

get.summary: Autocomplete search for tickets by ID, ticket number or departure date
get.description: Returns up to 8 matching tickets. Excludes ticket IDs passed in `ticketsIds`.

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: Search string (ticket/passenger ID, date, or ticket number)

parameters.name: ticketsIds
parameters.description: JSON array of ticket IDs to exclude from results

get.summary: List all discounts
get.description: Returns all discount types (student, pensioner, child, etc.) plus a synthetic "No discount" entry with `id: "0"`. Used to populate discount dropdowns in the admin ticket form.

get.summary: List all cities with their route assignments
get.description: Returns cities enriched with the routes they appear on (as onboarding or outboarding stop) and their sort order within each route.

get.summary: List bus flights (paginated, filterable, sortable)

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Row offset (pagination)

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Page size

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: JSON-serialised filter array `[{id, value}]`

parameters.name: filtersFns
parameters.description: JSON-serialised filter-function map {fieldId: fnName}

parameters.name: sorting
parameters.description: JSON-serialised sort array `[{id, desc}]`

get.summary: Available departure dates for a city pair (admin ticket form)
get.description: Returns the dates that have at least one flight with free seats for the given origin/destination and direction. Mirrors the public `/api/bus-flights/available-dates` contract; used to pre-populate the departure ("Пункт відправлення") and return ("Пункт повернення") date pickers in the admin ticket form (call once per column with the matching direction).

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Only return dates on or after this date (defaults to today)

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: `forwards` = origin→destination (departure), `backwards` = return leg

get.summary: Get a single bus flight by ID

delete.description: Also deletes the associated discount row (if any).

post.description: Creates a new admin user. The account must be activated via the email link before login is possible.

data.description: New user record (without tokens — account not yet activated)

post.description: Authenticates an admin user. Returns a short-lived `accessToken` in the response body and sets a `refreshToken` HTTP-only cookie.

accessToken.description: JWT access token — pass as Authorization: Bearer <token>

get.summary: Admin logout
get.description: Invalidates the refresh token and clears the `refreshToken` cookie.

get.summary: Activate admin account via email link
get.description: Activates the account and redirects to the admin login page.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Activation UUID from the registration email

get.summary: Refresh admin access token
get.description: Issues a new `accessToken` using the `refreshToken` HTTP-only cookie. Also rotates the refresh token.

get.summary: List all agents
get.description: Returns all agents plus a synthetic "No agent" entry with `id: "0"`. Used to populate agent dropdowns in the admin ticket form.
